title: First BG reading not displayed on main screen
body:
AAPS: 3.2.0-dev-l
xDrip+: c53c844-2023.08.27
Dexcom G6

Steps:
1. Uninstall the AAPS 3.2.0-dev-k application and install the new version.
2. Wait for the next BG value in xDrip+ to be sent to AAPS.
 
The first BG value arrives in xDrip+ and AAPS as seen in the **XDRIP+ BG** tab, but it is not displayed in the main screen. Not displaying the value is only an issue for the first value.

Here are attached screenshots and log file:
